usage.guide: Do not call until the canonical Orbis slug is confirmed: the QA task brief and the registry spec disagree (2e3f1d vs e020f1) and for an Orbis proxy the slug is the route, so a wrong slug charges you and returns 404. Once the correct slug is known, POST a JSON invoice body like {from, to, number, currency, items:[{name, quantity, unit_cost}]} (the input schema is empty so these field names are a best-guess from the service description and may need adjustment on a 422). Pay exactly once — Orbis has a charge-then-404 pattern, so if the post-payment response is 404/HTML/refund, treat the endpoint as broken and stop. Expect either PDF invoice bytes or a structured invoice JSON in the response body.
